ragStatus.title: RAG Status
ragStatus.description: ANSWERED, NO_SOURCE, VALIDATION_ERROR, AUTH_ERROR, BACKEND_ERROR, CALLOUT_FAILED, MALFORMED_RESPONSE, UNEXPECTED_ERROR, or NOT_ANSWERED.

safeMessage.title: Safe Message
safeMessage.description: Customer-safe status message Agentforce can display.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: Source-grounded answer returned by the AI API, or explicit no-source uncertainty.

sourceCount.title: Source Count
sourceCount.description: Number of authorized sources returned with the answer.

sourceIds.title: Source Ids
sourceIds.description: Semicolon-separated source ids used by the answer.

sourceTitles.title: Source Titles
sourceTitles.description: Semicolon-separated source titles used by the answer.

sourceUrls.title: Source URLs
sourceUrls.description: Semicolon-separated source URLs or Salesforce record references used by the answer.

sourceVersions.title: Source Versions
sourceVersions.description: Semicolon-separated source document versions used by the answer.

sourceChunkIds.title: Source Chunk Ids
sourceChunkIds.description: Semicolon-separated source chunk ids used by the answer.

retrievalIds.title: Retrieval Ids
retrievalIds.description: Safe retrieval ids from the AI API RAG workflow.

sourcesJson.title: Sources JSON
sourcesJson.description: Optional safe JSON source metadata without raw chunk text.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: LLM provider used by the AI API ModelRouter.

model.title: Model
model.description: LLM model used by the AI API ModelRouter.

embeddingProvider.title: Embedding Provider
embeddingProvider.description: Embedding provider used by the AI API.

embeddingModel.title: Embedding Model
embeddingModel.description: Embedding model used by the AI API.

vectorDbProvider.title: Vector DB Provider
vectorDbProvider.description: Vector database provider used by the AI API.

fallbackUsed.title: Fallback Used
fallbackUsed.description: True when the AI API ModelRouter used a fallback provider.

latencyMs.title: Latency Ms
latencyMs.description: AI API RAG workflow latency in milliseconds.

httpStatusCode.title: HTTP Status Code
httpStatusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the AI API Knowledge RAG endpoint.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: AI API endpoint called by Apex.

requestId.title: Request Id
requestId.description: Safe correlation id sent to backend telemetry.

answeredAt.title: Answered At
answeredAt.description: Timestamp when Apex ran Knowledge RAG.
